channel.title: LoomSci - Artificial Intelligence
channel.description: Latest Artificial Intelligence articles from LoomSci

item.title: When Impossibility Becomes a Blueprint for Trustworthy AI
item.description: The deterministic horizon of transformer architectures defines an information-theoretic ceiling for reasoning depth, turning an impossibility into a constructive design constraint for trustworthy AI.

item.title: The Database That Assembles Itself: The Bold Claim of Just-in-Time Systems
item.description: AI assembles a custom database on demand, challenging the centuries-old orthodoxy of pre-built software architectures with a fleeting, specialized tent.

item.title: When Size Doesn't Matter: The Hunt for Universality in Any-Dimensional Networks
item.description: A neural network that handles inputs of any size learns to operate on an infinite limit space, where permutation invariance and universality converge.

item.title: The Emulator That Turns Crop Models Into Discovery Engines
item.description: A neural network emulator accelerates crop simulations by orders of magnitude, enabling exhaustive discovery of climate-resilient phenotypes across thousands of weather scenarios.

item.title: When AI’s Certainty Hides Its Doubt
item.description: Polynomial chaos expansion acts as a prism, splitting AI's hidden epistemic doubt into a colored spectrum of decision vulnerabilities in molecular design.

item.title: How Many Weather Radars Are Hiding in Your Pocket?
item.description: Cellular base stations can be reprogrammed to detect rain by analyzing the backscatter of their own radio signals, offering street-level rainfall maps that outperform traditional weather radar in cities.

item.title: When Bias Tests Need a Baseline to Find Themselves
item.description: A gender swap and a harmless rephrase cause nearly identical answer flips in an AI diagnostic model, revealing that apparent bias may be universal jitteriness.

item.title: The Peril of Being Almost Right: Tightening AI's Injection Defenses
item.description: LocalAlign defends language models by training against near-correct prompt injections, tightening the boundary to stop attacks that barely miss.

item.title: The Brain That Thinks While Listening: Why Your Next AI Assistant Won’t Need to Pause
item.description: FLAIR enables AI to reason in latent embeddings while listening, removing the conversational pause between speaking and thinking.
